name: zw-corporate-income-tax
description: Zimbabwe corporate income tax, tax year 2026: 25% plus 3% AIDS levy, reduced rates for exporters, mining, licensed investors and special economic zones, BKPO services at 15%, the domestic minimum top-up tax, quarterly payment dates, the ITF12C return, the 50:50 currency rule, new permanent establishment tests and new credits and deductions from Finance Act 7 of 2025. Use for questions on company tax in Zimbabwe, QPD dates, ZIMRA corporate rates or withholding tax on dividends.
